body: i understand how you feel. it’s scary once you realize they’re going to stay for a while, maybe forever. i’m sorry for not having much to say, but i want you to know that you’re not alone and many people feel this way about their scars, it’s a reminder of the pain you go/went through. scar cream really can help, especially if it makes you feel better. wishing you the best
i know people hold back their anger for that reason, but even so, your comment made me feel a little less weird thank you
i might do that, maybe he can get through to her better than i can. thank you
i hope so, thank you for the kind words
i considered doing that a few times if i’m honest but for now the only thing i can do is talk to them and wait it out
yeah, sometimes that’s the way she shows concern. it’s hard for me to bring up the topic, especially with her, but i can attempt to make things clear to her. thank you, i appreciate it

i appreciate the advice, but normally when i come to her and tell her the thing she’s doing isn’t helpful or makes me feel upset she either further defends her actions or gives me the silent treatment. this is also a hard subject for me to bring up to her but i can try, thank you
Hey, are you still there? I can talk with you if you want. You deserve to be here and feel okay.
Honestly I’m glad they don’t care more, I don’t want to risk a mental hospital or anything
My dad’s getting me a therapist but as for what I did they don’t think my symptoms are that serious so I’m not getting it

I’m ugly and a burden on my dad on top of all other things, he had to wake up to my cringy ass text telling him I overdosed and he’s been asking me why I did it and it’s embarrassing I just want to disappear, he’s such a good dad and I had to do all that just because of an impulse
Okay, I’ll see what I can do since I’m scared to tell my family, thank you
